mapping_rule: Populate source_file/source_sheet/source_column and expected_file_sha256s only after inspecting the exact source bytes plus workbook notes or README. Production normalization requires each mapped outer source file to match its frozen SHA256; do not infer source columns from this template.
missing_value_rule: Preserve source missingness; no silent imputation.

mapping_entry_schema.header_row_semantics: one-based row containing exact source column names
mapping_entry_schema.columns_semantics: explicit normalized_field -> exact source column; no substring/fuzzy/position guessing
mapping_entry_schema.constants_semantics: explicit sheet-level normalized values such as year or population_id only after source verification
prohibited: mapping provenance fields from source columns
using a column absent from the exact source header
ZIP members with absolute paths, parent traversal, backslash separators, or duplicate member names
applying a SOURCE_VERIFIED_MAPPING to source bytes whose SHA256 differs from the reviewed file
mapping_entry_schema.source_file_semantics: standalone basename, or '<archive basename>::<member path>' for a tabular file inside an inventoried ZIP
mapping_entry_schema.required_source_binding: Each outer source file referenced by a sheet mapping must have a 64-hex SHA256 entry in the parent source expected_file_sha256s object before production normalization.

promotion_rule: Change status to SOURCE_VERIFIED_MAPPING only after source bytes and workbook notes/README have been inspected, every used source_file/source_sheet/header_row/source column has been verified, and expected_file_sha256s has been frozen for every mapped outer source file.
